minor_findings.evidence: The original says the one 28 cm tart serves ten to twelve people. The candidate preserves the one-tart and 28 cm meaning through the pastry-shell material, but does not preserve the ten-to-twelve serving guidance.

rationale: Apart from the serving-range omission, the candidate faithfully preserves the unusually detailed ingredients, prerequisite actions, parallel pear and custard branches, assembly join, baking conditions, completion criteria, and final tart.
